canonical_term: McMillen and Singh - Assessment Regressivity and Property Taxation
summary: Research connecting assessment regressivity to property tax incidence and showing how assessment patterns can offset or reverse statutory progressivity.
plain_language: Even if a tax relief design is progressive on paper, regressive assessments can change who actually bears the burden.

source_refs.citation: Daniel McMillen & Ruchi Singh, Assessment Regressivity and Property Taxation, J. Real Estate Finance & Econ. (2019/2020).
